design: Reuse H722 natural train/validation token documents, no task examples in fits. Capture L5 pre-output-projection head activations using exact six-block prefix. Fit train-centered coordinate PCA and residual-write-metric PCA, plus adaptive top-K in write PCA and three random orthogonal write-coordinate controls. All128 directions retained in fit objects; linear rank and adaptive active-coordinate budget distinguished. Natural validation MSE and reused H747 operation-difference write MSE, separately by native competence/format/query or source position. Adaptive difference is F(donor)-F(receiver), never F(delta).
limitations: Task-informed head selection, task-blind fits. Reused validation and task panels. No new causal fidelity evaluations or manifold conclusions from reconstruction. Fixed PCA subspaces have rankK; adaptive topK can use all128 directions across examples. Original reserved test untouched.
